children: Ater appointed William H. Crampton to its Board and its Audit and Compensation Committees effective September 25, 2026, following the resignation of Avraham Ben‑Tzvi.
Member of the Board; member of Audit Committee; member of Compensation Committee
Chief Executive Officer and Interim Chief Financial Officer
Retention letter dated September 29, 2026; payments on Sept 30, 2026 and following Form 10‑Q filing for quarter ended Sept 30, 2026
Not based on any disagreement with the Company on operations, policies, or practices
Board appointment; meets independence and eligibility requirements for committee service
In connection with continued leadership through the Retention Date
William H. Crampton appointed to the Board (effective Sept 25, 2026)

Age 63; CXO of Stealth Company since Feb 2026; VP Business Development of TO Viridi since Jul 2024; Co‑Founder & CEO of TreasureBeam (2003–2024); prior roles at New Horizons; degrees from MIT (AI cert), Univ. of Hawaii, Univ. of Illinois, Bridgewater State
Not disclosed beyond CEO and Interim CFO roles
Resigned from Board and all committees
Appointed to Audit Committee and Compensation Committee (effective Sept 25, 2026)
